This quest gives Assassins access to the [[Shing Jea Monastery]] and introduces the Assassin headmaster, Lee.

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = factions
| profession = Assassin
| primary = y
}}

===Objectives===
<!-- Quest objectives copied verbatim from ingame -->
* Talk to [[Ludo]] to gain entrance into the monastery.
* Seek out [[Headmaster Lee]] in the monastery.

===Reward===
<!-- Capture the reward given for completing the quest. -->
* 250 [[Experience]]
* 20 [[Gold]]

==Walkthrough==
<!-- Describe the steps required to complete the mission -->
Speak to Ludo at the entrance to Shing Jea Monastery to enter. If you skipped the tutorial [[Mantid Hatchlings]], you will learn the [[skill]]s
* {{skill icon|Shadow Refuge}}
* {{skill icon|Unsuspecting Strike}}
* {{skill icon|Resurrection Signet}}
gain 2,000 experience, and acquire a [[Starter Daggers]] after entering the monastery. You would have already received these if you did the tutorial. Speak to Headmaster Lee, who is nearby, for your reward.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Ludo
''Greetings and welcome, young one. You wish to become an Assassin? Then you should seek out [[Headmaster Lee]] in the monastery. She and her assistants will teach you everything you need to know.''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I'll seek out Headmaster Lee.
| decline = I'm not ready to begin my training yet.
| ask = [[Headmaster Lee]] will not like it if you are late. You should look for her in the monastery. Make haste!
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Headmaster Lee
''Ludo sent you? Excellent. Your training begins now.''

==Notes==
*If you abandon this quest, it cannot be retaken, but you can take the following quest immediately.
